ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises

text.en: PM Vishwakarma provides end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople to scale up their conventional products and services.

description.quote: PM Vishwakarma is a new scheme and envisages to provide end-to-end holistic support to the traditional artisans and craftspeople in scaling up of their conventional products and services.

text.en: Recognition as a Vishwakarma through a certificate and ID card.

benefits.quote: Recognition: Recognition as Vishwakarma through Certificate and ID Card

text.en: Skill verification followed by 5–7 days (40 hours) of basic training; optional 15 days (120 hours) of advanced training; training stipend of ₹500 per day.

benefits.quote: Skilling: a. Skill Verification followed by 5-7 days (40 hours) Basic Training b. Interested candidates can also enroll for 15 days (120 hours) Advanced Training c. Training Stipend: Rs 500 per day

text.en: Collateral-free enterprise development loans: ₹1 lakh (first tranche, 18 months repayment) and ₹2 lakh (second tranche, 30 months repayment), at a concessional 5% interest charged to the beneficiary.

benefits.quote: Credit Support: a. Collateral free Enterprise Development Loans: Rs 1 lakh (First Tranche for 18 months repayment) & Rs 2 lakh (Second Tranche for 30 months repayment) b. Concessional Rate of Interest: 5% to be charged from the beneficiary

text.en: Digital transaction incentive of ₹1 per transaction, for up to 100 transactions a month.

benefits.quote: Incentive for Digital Transaction: Re 1 per transaction for maximum upto100 transactions (monthly)

text.en: You must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades listed by the scheme, self-employed in the unorganised sector.

statement.quote: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools and engaged in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades mentioned in the scheme, in unorganized sector on self-employment basis, shall be eligible for registration under PM Vishwakarma.

text.en: Eligible trades include carpenter, boat maker, armourer, blacksmith, hammer and tool kit maker, locksmith, sculptor/stone breaker, goldsmith, potter, cobbler/footwear artisan, mason, basket/mat/broom maker/coir weaver, traditional doll and toy maker, barber, garland maker, washerman, tailor and fishing net maker.

statement.quote: Eligible Trades Wood Based Carpenter (Suthar) Boat Maker Iron/Metal Based*/ Stone Based Armourer Blacksmith (Lohar) Hammer and Tool Kit Maker Locksmith Sculptor (Moortikar, stone carver), Stone Breaker Gold/Silver Based Goldsmith (Sunar) Clay Based Potter (Kumhaar) Leather Based Cobbler (Charmakar)/ Shoesmith/ Footwear Artisan Architecture/ Construction Mason (Raajmistri) Others Basket/ Mat/ Broom Maker/ Coir Weaver Doll & Toy Maker (Traditional) Barber (Naai) Garland Maker (Malakaar) Washerman (Dhobi) Tailor (Darzi) Fishing Net Maker

text.en: You must be at least 18 years old on the date of registration.

statement.quote: The minimum age of the beneficiary should be 18 years on the date of registration.

text.en: You must be working in the trade on the date of registration and must not have taken loans in the past 5 years under similar Central or State credit schemes for self-employment (for example PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra).

statement.quote: The beneficiary should be engaged in the concerned trade on the date of registration and should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central Government or State Government for self-employment/ business development, e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra, in the past 5 years.

text.en: Registration and benefits are limited to one member of the family (husband, wife and unmarried children).

statement.quote: The registration and benefits under the Scheme shall be restricted to one member of the family. For availing benefits under the Scheme, a ‘family’ is defined as consisting of the husband, wife and unmarried children.

text.en: A person in government service, and their family members, are not eligible.

statement.quote: A person in government service and their family members shall not be eligible under the Scheme.

quotes: PM Vishwakarma is a new scheme and envisages to provide end-to-end holistic support to the traditional artisans and craftspeople in scaling up of their conventional products and services.

An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools and engaged in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades mentioned in the scheme, in unorganized sector on self-employment basis, shall be eligible for registration under PM Vishwakarma.
The minimum age of the beneficiary should be 18 years on the date of registration.

The beneficiary should be engaged in the concerned trade on the date of registration and should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central Government or State Government for self-employment/ business development, e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra, in the past 5 years.

The registration and benefits under the Scheme shall be restricted to one member of the family. For availing benefits under the Scheme, a ‘family’ is defined as consisting of the husband, wife and unmarried children.
A person in government service and their family members shall not be eligible under the Scheme.
